How much can a partner earn from the HitPay Reseller Partner Program?

A partner earns 0.1% of the total transaction volume processed by each linked merchant per month. For example, a merchant processing S$1,000,000/month generates S$1,000 in monthly commission. There is no cap on the number of merchants or total commission amount.
